new_method: A full formal frame gives a semisimple module after ramification. A trivial quotient on the seed submodule extends to the full formal module. Nonzero exponential factors have no horizontal map to the base trivial module; if every zero-exponential scalar seed value has positive local-parameter valuation, no extension can take the seed to1. This handles integer exponents as well as noninteger ones. Fixed polynomial phase blocks are lifted by the coefficientwise conjugacy ell(exp(F_r-F0)*a), yielding formally trivial blocks and an invertible leading matrix without assuming Morse critical points.
new_geometry: Cuspidal affine normal form T*(u^2+gamma*v+h)+v^3+buv+eu+fv+k retains full Q. The nonisotropic Gaussian phase has length2 at projective infinity and affine/twisted rank6. Seven parameter profiles, including fixed quartic/cubic blocks and multiscale Morse groups, exhaust rank6. Every zero-exponential seed prefactor is t^-1, t^-5/6 or a positive finite A_mu character. No arbitrary fixed phase or infinity contribution is omitted.
